scope: Object-local experimental-print bridge review. No physical support-free, strength, surface-quality or product acceptance claim.

c6_body.native_flags: Floating-cantilever notice; no supports generated by probe.
c6_body.witness: External Bridge strokes at Z22.6 have maximum length 1.283mm; Overhang wall strokes at Z27.4 are about 1.2mm. Internal Bridge labels at floor and upper infill are retained separately and are not whole unsupported-air spans.
c6_body.interpretation: Receiver uses the E roof/keyway geometry; hinge ears are connected to supported sloping webs. Native warning is retained. Physical underside quality and hinge fit still need a print.

c6_lid.native_flags: Support probe suggests trees at the front rail and the two hinge bores.
c6_lid.witness: Z32.0 external bridge strokes span 11.601mm at the nominal 12mm rail opening. Z27.4 bridge/overhang strokes include the small bores, maximum 4.212mm.
c6_lid.interpretation: Crossbar has two CAD end supports and matches the accepted E bridge span, with a new thinner radial section. Hinge-bore bridges are local. Test the small loop first; full experimental lid is not a sag-free or travel-qualified recommendation.

c6_latch_test.native_flags: Floating-cantilever notice; support probe suggests a tree below the short-loop rail.
c6_latch_test.witness: Four external bridge strokes at Z32.0 span 11.6mm between the two leaves; suggested support rises to Z31.6 below that rail. Other external bridges are about 1.282mm at Z22.6. Internal Bridge strokes are not classified as unsupported-air spans.
c6_latch_test.interpretation: Experimental supports-off bridge trial is selected to avoid scarring the retaining land with support contact. The successful E reference has the same nominal bridge span, but this thinner rail remains unprinted. Inspect underside sag and reject a distorted shoulder before assessing force.
